comment: Read from src/STVCA at commit 37a37b0, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.3, alongside the plugin's wiki page for ST-VCA. The wiki says only that it works like the Fundamental VCA in stereo, which the code bears out. The EXP switch's hover text reads Response mode with the choices Exponential and Linear (STVCA.cpp:34) and the exponential curve is the control voltage to the fourth power (STVCA.cpp:80). The level control is a slider drawn inside the display area rather than a knob.
